class.name: TestCase
class.brief_description: What a test script extends: its test_ methods are run by [code]purr --run-tests[/code].

method.name: _after_all
method.description: Called once after the script's last test. Can [code]await[/code].

method.name: _after_each
method.description: Called after each test, even one that failed. Can [code]await[/code].

method.name: _before_all
method.description: Called once before the script's first test. If it fails an assertion, the script's tests are skipped. Can [code]await[/code].

method.name: _before_each
method.description: Called before each test. Can [code]await[/code].

method.name: assert_almost_equal
method.description: Fails unless [param actual] is about [param expected]: numbers, vectors, colours, quaternions, bases and transforms close enough to count as equal, as [method @GlobalScope.is_equal_approx] and their own [code]is_equal_approx()[/code] decide. [param message] says what was being checked.

method.name: assert_equal
method.description: Fails unless [param actual] equals [param expected], as [code]==[/code] decides. [param message] says what was being checked, and shows beside what was expected and what came instead.

method.name: assert_false
method.description: Fails if [param condition] is true.

method.name: assert_greater
method.description: Fails unless [param actual] is more than [param than].

method.name: assert_has
method.description: Fails unless [param value] is in [param container], as GDScript's [code]in[/code] decides: an item of an array, a key of a dictionary, a part of a string.

method.name: assert_less
method.description: Fails unless [param actual] is less than [param than].

method.name: assert_not_equal
method.description: Fails if [param actual] equals [param expected].

method.name: assert_not_null
method.description: Fails if [param value] is [code]null[/code] or a freed object.

method.name: assert_null
method.description: Fails unless [param value] is [code]null[/code] or a freed object.

method.name: assert_true
method.description: Fails unless [param condition] is true.

method.name: fail
method.description: Fails the test with [param message].

method.name: measure
method.description: Calls [param step] once a frame for [param frames] frames, timing each call alone, and returns a signal to await. It comes with a [Dictionary] of [code]median_ms[/code], [code]p95_ms[/code] (95 calls in 100 come within it), [code]worst_ms[/code] and, if this test measured [param what] before on this computer, [code]last_run_ms[/code]. It also prints them, with the change since the last run: [codeblock] var timed: Dictionary = await measure("traffic", func(): traffic.update(1.0 / 60.0)) assert_less(timed.median_ms, 2.0) [/codeblock] [param step] shouldn't await: only its time up to the first [code]await[/code] is counted.

method.name: skip
method.description: Marks the test as skipped, with [param reason]. Return after calling it: the rest of the test still runs otherwise. A skipped test that also fails an assertion counts as failed.

method.name: wait_for
method.description: Returns a signal to await that comes when [param signal] is emitted, with [code]true[/code], or after [param timeout] seconds, with [code]false[/code]: [codeblock] assert_true(await wait_for(door.opened), "the door opened") [/codeblock]

method.name: wait_frames
method.description: Returns a signal to await that comes after [param count] frames.

method.name: wait_physics_frames
method.description: Returns a signal to await that comes after [param count] physics ticks.

method.name: wait_seconds
method.description: Returns a signal to await that comes after [param seconds].
